purpose: Non-qualifying mechanism diagnosis of whether residual heterogeneous-geometry TTF-C failure is associated with local concentration of training-system kernel mass and sensitivity of the learned field to leaving out one training system. This defines no repair candidate and cannot qualify TTF-C.
diagnostic_question: When total cross-split kernel support is adequate, does concentration of that support among a few training systems make the learned field unstable and thereby contribute to private false transfer or shifted-geometry power loss in TTF-C?

fixed_estimators.ttf_m: frozen Q5 heterogeneous estimator: raw mismatch turnover in train and held-out systems, prior mean 0.5
fixed_estimators.ttf_c: frozen Q5.1 estimator: training coupling turnover length-orthogonalized within system; held-out coupling turnover raw; ordinary held-out Spearman; prior mean 0.0

training_leverage_object.local_system_mass: At each held-out quadrature point, sum the frozen Gaussian kernel weights separately within each training system. Normalize those system masses by their response-blind total kernel mass.
training_leverage_object.effective_training_system_count: 1/sum_s(q_s^2) at each quadrature point, averaged over edge then held-out systems; q_s is the local training-system mass share.
training_leverage_object.dominant_training_system_share: max_s(q_s) at each quadrature point, averaged over edge then held-out systems.
training_leverage_object.leave_one_training_system_out: For each training system s, compute the exact field after removing all edges of s while keeping the frozen bandwidth, prior strength, prior mean, quadrature and all remaining species weights unchanged. LOO predictions are obtained exactly by subtracting the precomputed system-specific numerator and denominator contributions.

per_world_endpoints: raw_M and raw_C frozen full-training statistics
loo_score_sd_M and loo_score_sd_C across all training-system deletions
mean_prediction_loo_sd_M and mean_prediction_loo_sd_C across held-out edges

interpretation_tests.private_relation_field_leverage: On DTL_PRIVATE_C worlds, bootstrap across-world Spearman(raw_C, loo_score_sd_C) and Spearman(raw_C, mean_prediction_loo_sd_C). Support requires both lower95 > 0.
interpretation_tests.private_relation_geometry_concentration: On DTL_PRIVATE_C worlds, bootstrap Spearman(raw_C, dominant_training_system_share) and Spearman(raw_C, effective_training_system_count). Support requires dominant-share lower95 > 0 and effective-count upper95 < 0.
interpretation_tests.private_mismatch_field_leverage: Apply the same field-leverage diagnostic on DTL_PRIVATE_M worlds; report without repair selection.
interpretation_tests.shifted_power_training_instability: Compare DTL_POWER_M_SHIFTED with DTL_POWER_M_MATCHED using independent bootstrap. Support requires lower95(loo_score_sd_C_shifted - matched) > 0 and upper95(raw_C_shifted - matched) < 0.
interpretation_tests.estimand_specificity: Within DTL_PRIVATE_M and DTL_POWER_M_MATCHED worlds, compare loo_score_sd_C - loo_score_sd_M. Specificity requires lower95 > 0 in at least one role; otherwise do not call instability TTF-C-specific.
interpretation_tests.shared_relation_negative_control: Report raw C, mean/min LOO C score and LOO score SD for DTL_POWER_C_MATCHED and DTL_POWER_C_SHIFTED; no repair gate is imposed.

terminal_rule.if_supported: Freeze only the training-leverage diagnosis. Any corrective estimator must be specified later in a newly named prospective development family with fresh worlds.
terminal_rule.if_not_supported: Freeze the negative diagnosis and do not tune leverage penalties, training-system caps, or training-resampling inference on these worlds. A different newly named mechanism diagnosis would be required.
